_comment: Model registry for the fleet router. Open/free LOCAL models are always tried first, chosen by capability. Cloud is escalation only. Update this file as you pull new local models (ollama pull ...).
policy: Try local first, every time. Escalate to cloud ONLY on: local failure, low-confidence self-check, or task explicitly flagged user_facing_final / high_stakes.

qwen3:8b.note: FLEET DEFAULT. Fits 12GB VRAM at small ctx; safe under the 16GB RAM pressure. All 5 cron agents run on this.

qwen3:14b.note: Daily-driver target once 64GB RAM lands. Today: only via safe_model gate (downgrades to 8b under memory pressure, which is ~always on 16GB).

deepseek-r1:14b.note: Hard logic/math/debugging — keeps 'hard' tasks LOCAL instead of escalating to paid cloud. Heavy on 16GB; reserve for latency-tolerant router tasks.

recommended_pulls._note: Tuned to Brian's rig (RTX 4070 Super 12GB VRAM, 16GB RAM) per hardware analysis 2026-06-16. All fit and run local/free.
recommended_pulls.qwen3:14b: DAILY DRIVER — Q4 ~9GB, fits VRAM. Strong general + coding. Handles moderate/complex.
recommended_pulls.qwen3:8b: FAST HELPER ~5GB — quick answers, summaries, small coding. Handles simple/trivial faster than llama3.
recommended_pulls.deepseek-r1:14b: REASONING ~9GB — hard logic/math/debugging. Keeps 'hard' tasks LOCAL instead of escalating to paid cloud.
recommended_pulls.nomic-embed-text: embeddings for search/retrieval across Harmony + comms (small).

cloud_fallback._note: Escalation only. Requires an API key in ~/.hermes/.env (never committed). One OpenRouter key reaches most of these. Ladder + costs from the 2026-06-17 model review (see MODELS_AND_TOOLS_REVIEW_2026-06-17.md). GLM-5.2/Kimi are CLOUD-only — far too big to run on a 12GB/16GB box.

complexity_to_model._note: Capability map. On a 16GB box these pass through fleet_common.model_for(), which downgrades any 14B target to qwen3:8b under memory pressure (so 'moderate' is effectively 8B today). Once 64GB RAM lands, set FLEET_MODEL=qwen3:14b in ONE place and the 14B targets light up. gemma4:26b removed 2026-06-18 (too big for this hardware).
